label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Im leads FedEx St. Jude
items.text: Sungjae Im finished Round 1 at 8-under with a 66 to lead the FedEx St. Jude Championship at TPC Southwind; Patrick Cantlay, Jake Knapp, and Adam Scott trail at 6-under.

items.headline: MacIntyre withdraws with injury
items.text: Robert MacIntyre withdrew before Round 2 at the FedEx St. Jude Championship due to a knee injury after shooting 82 in Round 1 and ranking last by eight shots.

items.headline: Galdiano tops Portland Classic
items.text: Mariel Galdiano posted a 7-under 65 in Thursday’s opening round to lead The Standard Portland Classic at Columbia-Edgewater Country Club, with amateur Marin one stroke behind.
